columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: ad_group_criterion_keyword_text
columns.comment: The text of the keyword (at most 80 characters and 10 words).

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.comment: The name of the ad group. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new ad groups. It must contain fewer than 255 UTF-8 full-width characters. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: campaign_advertising_channel_sub_type
columns.comment: Optional refinement to `advertising_channel_type`. Must be a valid sub-type of the parent channel type. Can be set only when creating campaigns. After campaign is created, the field can not be changed.

columns.name: campaign_bidding_strategy_type
columns.comment: The type of bidding strategy. A bidding strategy can be created by setting either the bidding scheme to create a standard bidding strategy or the `bidding_strategy` field to create a portfolio bidding strategy. This field is read-only.

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.comment: The name of the campaign. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new campaigns. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpc
columns.comment: The total cost of all clicks divided by the total number of clicks received.

columns.name: metrics_average_cpm
columns.comment: Average cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM).

columns.name: metrics_average_cpv
columns.comment: The average amount you pay each time someone views your ad. The average CPV is defined by the total cost of all ad views divided by the number of views.

columns.name: metrics_clicks
columns.comment: The number of clicks.

columns.name: metrics_conversions
columns.comment: The number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_from_interactions_rate
columns.comment: Conversions from interactions divided by the number of ad interactions (such as clicks for text ads or views for video ads). This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cost_micros
columns.comment: The sum of your cost-per-click (CPC) and cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) costs during this period.

columns.name: metrics_cost_per_conversion
columns.comment: The cost of ad interactions divided by conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_impressions
columns.comment: Count of how often your ad has appeared on a search results page or website on the Google Network.

columns.name: metrics_interaction_rate
columns.comment: How often people interact with your ad after it is shown to them. This is the number of interactions divided by the number of times your ad is shown.

columns.name: metrics_interactions
columns.comment: The number of interactions. An interaction is the main user action associated with an ad format-clicks for text and shopping ads, views for video ads, and so on.

columns.name: metrics_trueview_average_cpv
columns.comment: The average amount you pay each time someone views your ad. The average CPV is defined by the total cost of all ad views divided by the number of TrueView views.

columns.name: metrics_view_through_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of view-through conversions. These happen when a customer sees an image or rich media ad, then later completes a conversion on your site without interacting with (e.g., clicking on) another ad.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of the week, e.g., MONDAY.

columns.name: segments_month
columns.comment: Month as represented by the date of the first day of a month. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_quarter
columns.comment: Quarter as represented by the date of the first day of a quarter. Uses the calendar year for quarters, e.g., the second quarter of 2018 starts on 2018-04-01. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_week
columns.comment: Week as defined as Monday through Sunday, and represented by the date of Monday. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_year
columns.comment: Year, formatted as yyyy.
